name: Cocoanut Pie No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sifted white sugar
ingredients.originalText: four tablespoonfuls of sifted white sugar

instructions.text: Cut off the brown part of the cocoanut, grate the white part
Mix it with milk and set it on the fire and let it boil slowly eight or ten minutes
The eggs and sugar should be beaten together to a froth
Put them into the milk and cocoanut, which should be first allowed to get quite cool
Turn the whole into deep pie plates, with a lining and rim of puff paste
Bake them as soon as turned into the plates

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut off the brown part of the cocoanut, grate the white part
2. Mix it with milk and set it on the fire and let it boil slowly eight or ten minutes
3. The eggs and sugar should be beaten together to a froth
4. Stir in the wine
5. Put them into the milk and cocoanut, which should be first allowed to get quite cool
6. Add the cracker and nutmeg
7. Turn the whole into deep pie plates, with a lining and rim of puff paste
8. Bake them as soon as turned into the plates
